_what: Impact numbers shown on the home and About stats bands, displayed rounded DOWN to a friendly floor with a '+'. artifacts = public model count on the Tanit XR Sketchfab profile (sketchfab.com/TanitXR), re-verified 2026-09-21: now 102, up from 99 on 2026-09-18 (the building-kit uploads) -> shows 100+. Note the gap: ref/archive-data.json publishes only 42 artifact pairs, so the website archive shows far fewer artifacts than Sketchfab hosts - worth closing by adding the missing models to the archive. sites = distinct 'place' values in archive-data.json (Byrsa Hill, the Tophet, Baths of Antoninus, the Roman villas, Medina of Tunis, Water Temple of Zaghouan, Zawiya of Sidi Sahbi, the flood-revealed Neapolis site); the coarser 'site' grouping used by the archive filters is 5 (Carthage, Kairouan, Medina of Tunis, Neapolis, Zaghouan). volunteers = members of the Tanit XR Slack workspace (Ines, 2026-09-12: 85+); NOT re-verified since - the Slack connector exposes no member count. reach = unique people reached by Ines's LinkedIn content. SOURCED 2026-09-21 from her LinkedIn creator content analytics export (Desktop/'Content analytics | LinkedIn.pdf', range 2025-08-18 to 2026-09-21): 32,067 members reached, from 170,511 impressions (61% in-network, 39% out-of-network) and 6,651 social engagements. 'Members reached' is the unique-people figure and is what the label 'People reached online' claims, so that is the number used; it displays as '32k+'. The previous value was 100000, which had no source on file and was flagged for Ines on 2026-09-21 (hold item 'reach-stat-100k'); she answered by sending the analytics export. Two notes for the future: this counts the trailing 13 months of LinkedIn only, so it excludes the newsletter's 1,946 subscribers, the Tanit XR page's 456 followers and all press (Al Jazeera, Voices of VR, Niantic, Carthage Magazine), which makes it conservative; and if the label ever changes from 'People reached' to 'views' or 'impressions', the defensible number becomes 170,511.
